documentation: Stage prop for the operator at the instrument. Write true; the gateway tag-change script POSTs to sim-apconnect /measure and writes this back to false, so it can be pressed again. Ignition never INSERTs into the apconnect catalog - see checkpoint 10.
name: measure_now

documentation: Clear to stall the poll. The timer still fires; poll_turbidity.tick() returns immediately. Set true again and the backlog drains in measurement_no order - that burst is the catch-up visual.
name: poll_enabled

documentation: The other implementation, one flag away. When true the tick advances the watermark to max(measurement_no) WITHOUT publishing, so a stall loses rows instead of arriving late. Live code on purpose: catch-up first, then flip this and show the numbers skip.
name: poll_jump

documentation: High-water mark on measurement.measurement_no. Deliberately a memory tag: a gateway restart resets it to 0 and the next tick replays from the beginning. That at-least-once behaviour is honest and is checkpoint 9 - do not make it durable in v1.
name: poll_watermark
